question:
15. With consideration of following trial balance and adjustments of Harsh and Yesha, prepare final accounts for the year ending on 31-3-17 of their firm.

Trial Balance of Partnership Firm of Harsh and Yesha as on 31-3-2017

| Name of Accounts | Debit balance (₹) | Credit balance (₹) |
|---|---|---|
| Capital and drawings : Harsh | 5000 | 35,000 |
| Capital and drawings : Yesha | 2500 | 15,000 |
| Goodwill | 5000 | - |
| Patent and Trade-mark | 2700 | - |
| Receivables and payables | 31,000 | 25,000 |
| Accounts of goods | 40,000 | 89,250 |
| Machines (office) | 15,000 | - |
| Opening stock | 6000 | - |
| Furniture | 3000 | - |
| Goods return accounts | 7500 | 5000 |
| Wages | 4000 | - |
| Depreciation on furniture | 300 | - |
| Stationery and printing | 1550 | - |
| Building | 46,000 | - |
| Legal charges | 6500 | - |
| Cash balance | 300 | - |
| Railway frieght | 600 | - |
| Insurance premium | 1150 | - |
| Bills | 4000 | 2500 |
| Postage expense | 2000 | - |
| Bad debts and bad debts reserve | 1500 | 2000 |
| Discounts | 750 | 1500 |
| Stamps on hand and bad debts return | 150 | 1250 |
| 12 % HDFC loan (1-7-16) | - | 10,000 |
| **Total** | **1,86,500** | **1,86,500** |

**Adjustments :**
(1) Closing stock = 10,000 out of which 50 % has no market value.
(2) Legal charges included of legal charges of building purchase = 4000.
(3) Provide 5 % bad debts reserve on debtors.
(4) Provide depreciation 10 % on furniture and 5 % on building.
(5) 1/4 share of patent and trade mark is to be written off.
question_hi:
15. हर्ष और येशा की साझेदारी पेढ़ी का निम्नलिखित काचा सरवैया (Trial Balance) और हवालों (Adjustments) को ध्यान में रखकर 31-3-17 को पूरे होने वाले वर्ष के लिए पेढ़ी के अंतिम खाते (Final Accounts) तैयार कीजिए।

हर्ष और येशा की साझेदारी पेढ़ी का 31-3-2017 के दिन का काचा सरवैया

| खातों के नाम | उधार बाकी (₹) | जमा बाकी (₹) |
|---|---|---|
| पूंजी और आहरण : हर्ष | 5000 | 35,000 |
| पूंजी और आहरण : येशा | 2500 | 15,000 |
| ख्याति (Goodwill) | 5000 | - |
| पेटेंट और ट्रेडमार्क | 2700 | - |
| प्राप्य और देय | 31,000 | 25,000 |
| माल के खाते | 40,000 | 89,250 |
| मशीन (कार्यालय) | 15,000 | - |
| प्रारंभिक स्टॉक | 6000 | - |
| फर्नीचर | 3000 | - |
| माल वापसी खाते | 7500 | 5000 |
| मजदूरी | 4000 | - |
| फर्नीचर पर घिसाई | 300 | - |
| स्टेशनरी और छपाई | 1550 | - |
| भवन | 46,000 | - |
| कानूनी खर्च | 6500 | - |
| नकद शेष | 300 | - |
| रेलवे भाड़ा | 600 | - |
| बीमा प्रीमियम | 1150 | - |
| बिल | 4000 | 2500 |
| डाक खर्च | 2000 | - |
| डूबत ऋण और डूबत ऋण संचिति | 1500 | 2000 |
| बट्टा (छूट) | 750 | 1500 |
| हाथ पर स्टाम्प और डूबत ऋण वापसी | 150 | 1250 |
| 12 % HDFC का ऋण (1-7-16) | - | 10,000 |
| **कुल** | **1,86,500** | **1,86,500** |

**हवाले (Adjustments):**
(1) अंतिम स्टॉक = 10,000 जिसमें से 50 % का बाजार मूल्य नहीं है।
(2) कानूनी खर्च में भवन खरीद का कानूनी खर्च = 4000 शामिल है।
(3) देनदारों पर 5 % डूबत ऋण संचिति का प्रावधान कीजिए।
(4) फर्नीचर पर 10 % और भवन पर 5 % घिसाई का प्रावधान कीजिए।
(5) पेटेंट और ट्रेडमार्क का 1/4 भाग अपलिखित (write off) करना है।
solution: This is a comprehensive subjective question requiring preparation of Final Accounts. Please prepare Trading Account, Profit and Loss Account, Profit and Loss Appropriation Account, Partners' Capital Accounts, and Balance Sheet.
solution_hi: यह एक व्यापक विषयनिष्ठ प्रश्न है जिसमें अंतिम खाते तैयार करने की आवश्यकता है। कृपया व्यापार खाता, लाभ-हानि खाता, लाभ-हानि विनियोग खाता, साझीदारों के पूंजी खाते और पक्की तलपट (Balance Sheet) तैयार करें।
solution_gu: આ એક વિસ્તૃત વ્યક્તિલક્ષી પ્રશ્ન છે જેમાં વાર્ષિક હિસાબો તૈયાર કરવાની જરૂર છે. કૃપા કરીને વેપાર ખાતું, નફા-નુકસાન ખાતું, નફા-નુકસાન ફાળવણી ખાતું, ભાગીદારોના મૂડી ખાતા અને પાકું સરવૈયું તૈયાર કરો.

question:
16. Neela and Sheela are partners of partnership firm sharing profit-loss in capital proportion. From the following trial balance and adjustments prepare final accounts of the firm.

Trial balance of Partnership Firm of Neela and Sheela as on 31-3-17

| Name of Accounts | Debit balances (₹) | Credit balances (₹) |
|---|---|---|
| Neela's capital and drawings | 20,000 | 1,00,000 |
| Sheela's capital and drawings | 14,000 | 50,000 |
| Suppliers and customers | 90,000 | 60,000 |
| Goods returned | 2000 | 3000 |
| Bills | 15,000 | 20,800 |
| Cash and Bank | 1000 | 14,000 |
| Bad debts and bad debts reserve | 400 | 1300 |
| Purchase and sales | 1,40,000 | 2,60,500 |
| Wages and outstanding wages | 35,000 | 2000 |
| Machinery (office) | 36,500 | - |
| Depreciation on machinery | 3500 | - |
| Furniture | 12,000 | - |
| Opening stock | 46,100 | - |
| Prepaid insurance | 200 | - |
| Salary | 23,000 | - |
| Insurance premium | 2000 | - |
| Rent-taxes | 12,000 | - |
| Advertisement expenses | 2900 | - |
| Goodwill | 72,000 | - |
| Leasehold building (from 1-10-14 for 5 years) | 14,000 | - |
| 8 % Leela's loan (1-11-16) | - | 30,000 |
| **Total** | **5,41,600** | **5,41,600** |

**Adjustments :**
(1) Closing stock ₹ 1,10,000 and having market value 20 % more than book value.
(2) Per annum 6 % interest is payable on Partners’ capital.
(3) Interest on drawings recoverable from partners : Neela = 900, Sheela = 600.
(4) Provide 5 % bad debt reserve on debtors.
(5) Outstanding expenses at the end of accounting year : rent = 300 and salary = 950.
(6) Provide depreciation : 10 % on machinery and 5 % on furniture.
solution: This is a comprehensive subjective question requiring preparation of Final Accounts. Please prepare Trading Account, Profit and Loss Account, Profit and Loss Appropriation Account, Partners' Capital Accounts, and Balance Sheet.
